# CONFORMANCE FIXTURE -- an INDENTED `#` comment inside an entry.
# The gate ACCEPTS it (comments are ignored anywhere).
# The MCP's old hand-written parser PANICKED on it, tearing down the stdio connection
# that its own source comment swore it would never tear down -- and the panic text told
# you to run the check that was already passing.

E3010 SemanticUnneededCast
	csharp SemanticUnneededCast
	# the shv2 spelling is lowerCamel by convention
	shv2 unneededCast
	doc A cast is redundant: the value already has the destination type.

E5001 CodeEmitterRegisterPressure
	shv2 registerPressure
	doc Out of registers, and no spill placement is forced.
